'Kanata kara' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyouko Hikawa's Kanata kara (From Far Away) manga revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by AT-X, ABC TV, and WOWOW. Yuuji Yanase, Director of 'Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.', Dies at 59
Yuuji Yanase, the director behind Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni. (In Another World With My Smartphone), died on August 22 due to myocardial infarction. He was 59. A funeral service was held by his close relatives. Animation studio Maho Film announced the news on Wednesday, where Yanase had been a full-time employee since 2023. Focus: Building the Dark Fantasy "Sentenced to Be a Hero" with Studio KAI
Studio KAI was founded in 2019, and their name "KAI" means "oar" in Japanese. Since an oar is a tool used when rowing a boat, Studio KAI's mission is to row boldly into the endless ocean of animation with passion and determination. The result of this is the breathtaking character acting and jaw-dropping action that we saw in Sentenced to Be a Hero.
